resonance.description: Broadcasts a resonance event triggered from PhiFlow bytecode.

intention.description: The intention declared by the resonance block.

coherence.description: The coherence value at the time of resonance (0.0 to 1.0).

value.description: The numeric value associated with the resonance.

timestamp_ms.description: Milliseconds since epoch when the event was recorded.

id.description: Unique UUID of the resonance message.
